item.title: Container Registry Replication: Skopeo vs Regsync vs Harbor (2026)
item.description: In a multi-cluster or multi-region Kubernetes deployment, keeping container images synchronized across registries is a critical operational challenge. Whether you’re mirroring Docker Hub images to an internal registry for air-gapped environments, replicating images between regional registries for low-latency pulls, or building a disaster recovery strategy for your container infrastructure — you need reliable registry replication tooling.
